1.title: Infrastructure Lead & Fullstack Developer
1.description: Fullstack web development and complete software architecture & infrastructure management for 50+ enterprise apps across Dev, QA, and Production environments, ensuring high availability, security, and resource optimization.
bullets: Developed and evolved enterprise web applications using PHP (Laravel), JavaScript, and MySQL/MariaDB, implementing business logic, CRUD modules, and REST APIs.
Managed and configured environments for 50+ applications, executing continuous deployments on Linux servers using Docker, Docker Compose, Nginx, and Apache.
Automated infrastructure workflows via IaC and scripts, reducing deployment time by 15% and operational errors by 20%.
Designed and implemented centralized monitoring with Grafana for 50+ applications and 10 servers, reducing incident detection time by 15%.
Led AWS Cloud and On-Premise infrastructure administration, maintaining >99.9% uptime for critical services.
Strengthened web application and server cybersecurity (SSL/TLS, hardening, vulnerability management), mitigating over 130 security findings.

bullets: Managed and optimized relational database queries, improving performance and stability for corporate applications used by 200+ users.

Provided L2 technical support for software platforms and infrastructure under ITIL guidelines, ensuring SLA compliance.
Administered Windows Server, VMware, and Hyper-V server environments, leading security management and data backups.

1.p1: Hi! I'm Juan Esteban Restrepo Ossa
1.p2: I am a Systems Engineer with experience in software development, Cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity. Throughout my career, I have worked on the administration, evolution, and operation of technology platforms — participating in projects that go from writing code to deploying it in production.
1.p3: For over 9 years I have operated in Cloud and On-Premise environments using technologies like AWS, Linux, Windows, VMware, and Docker, while building applications with JavaScript, PHP, Node.js, Vue.js, React, and REST APIs. This combination of profiles gives me a complete view of the software development lifecycle.
1.p4: I believe my greatest strength is understanding an application from the code all the way to the infrastructure it runs on. This perspective lets me design solutions with performance, security, availability, deployment, and scalability in mind from day one — not as an afterthought.
1.p5: Today I am focused on growing as a software developer, building products and solutions that combine solid programming practices, service integration, databases, and Cloud technologies — and that solve real problems.
1.p6: If you are looking for someone who understands both the business and the technology, who can collaborate from architecture to delivery, and who genuinely enjoys building things that work — let's talk!
